record.dic_text:
0771 'Ornan {or-na:n'}

可能源自 0766; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Ornan 12

阿珥楠 = "不熄之光: 他們的樅樹"
1) 一名耶布斯人, 他把一塊打穀場賣給大衛王作為修建祭壇之用
record.edic_text:
0771 'Ornan {or-nawn'}

probably from 0766;; n pr m

AV - Ornan 12

Ornan = "light was perpetuated: their fir trees"
1) a Jebusite who sold, to David, a threshing floor for an altar
